description: Editor status bar footer showing save and dirty state, a save message with optional retry, the last-saved time, runtime recovery messages, and document metrics such as word count, page count, active region, and zoom.

parameters.name: IsDirty
parameters.description: Whether the document has local unsaved changes.

parameters.name: LastSavedAt
parameters.description: Raised when the user requests retry after a recoverable save failure.

parameters.name: OnRetrySave
parameters.description: Whether the latest save failure can be retried.

parameters.name: PendingCount
parameters.description: Whether the document has local unsaved changes.

parameters.name: PendingMessage
parameters.description: Number of currently pending async operations.

parameters.name: RuntimeFailed
parameters.description: Message shown after a JS runtime recovery event, or null when none.

parameters.name: SaveMessage
parameters.description: Message of the first pending operation, or null when none.

parameters.name: WordCount
parameters.description: Timestamp of the latest successful save.

parameters.name: ZoomLabel
parameters.description: Label for the active editing region.
